about: Motion semantics the register matrix exposed on 2026-11-14. Both were pre-existing and unrelated to registers: they surfaced because the matrix pastes from a register, which turns a cursor/motion difference into a text difference. Measured against vim 9.2 and pinned here so the differential keeps checking them. Position IS compared: these are about where a motion lands, and the operator rules built on top of it.

cases.name: dt, is inclusive of the character t lands on
d} from a normal line stops before the blank line
d{ from the last paragraph stops before the cursor's line
d{ with the cursor on a blank line takes the paragraph before it
{ lands on the blank line, not on the cursor's own line
